text:
casey_sales: Quick thread: Prospect Solara needs a runway plan in the SOW. They say bursts up to ~5k QPS (chat-heavy) during promos. Need reserved floor + autoscale + cost delta.
omar_eng: Clarify mix and avg token size?
casey_sales: 75% chat (avg 220 tokens), 25% embed. Bursts ~60-90s every 10m.
omar_eng: BOE: 5k*0.75=3750 chat qps *220 = 825k tokens/s. At ~60k tok/s per GPU -> ~14 GPUs peak.
jen_ops: Recommend reserved_floor=12, autoscale_max=26, AZ spread and preheat. For p95<400ms either floor->16 or aggressive KV preheat + tighter batching.
paul_pm: Need failure-mode wording for legal: spot eviction, AZ outage, fallback model + expected quality delta and RTO.
infra-bot: preheat job scheduled job_id=preheat-Solara-1799999999 targets=kv-warm,model-cache,probe-rps
casey_sales: Omar please draft autoscale snippet + cost delta floor=12 vs 16 for SOW. Jen create runbook and proof preheat. Paul will draft legal text.
omar_eng: Will post a small spreadsheet and autoscale YAML by EOD.
jen_ops: I'll spin up smoke test this Friday and link runbook when ready.
casey_sales: Thanks all, keeping this tidy for AE review. :thumbsup:
